connector.name: Scope (Legal) by scope.bid
connector.registryDescription: Dispatch litigation work to legal-services vendors from any MCP-compatible AI workflow.
connector.summary: Hosted at scope.bid over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package scope-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace bid.scope, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCOPE_API_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the Scope API. Defaults to the hosted instance.

env.name: SCOPE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token from scope.bid/settings/api-tokens. Required for write tools.

env.name: SCOPE_ORG_SLUG
env.description: Pin reads/writes to a specific buyer organization.
